description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for testing the dashboard application, including mocking API endpoints, login automation, and seeding authentication tokens. It primarily adds intercepts for API routes related to users, reports, and charts, simulating backend responses for testing purposes.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up intercepted API endpoints to mock backend responses for login, users, reports, and charts. It provides realistic responses including fake data and validation checks for various CRUD operations.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Automates the login process by visiting the login page, filling in credentials, and submitting the form, then waits for the login API call to complete.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Seeds authentication tokens directly into localStorage to simulate an authenticated state without UI interaction.
